senses.meaning: Đại sứ quán (tòa nhà và nhân sự của đại sứ quán nước ngoài)
examples: She queued outside the embassy to apply for a visa.
The protesters gathered outside the American embassy.
The ambassador welcomed guests at the embassy reception.

senses.meaning: Nơi trú ẩn an toàn, chốn bình yên; thiên đường (về thuế hoặc tự do)
examples: The library was a haven for students during exam season.
Switzerland is considered a tax haven by many corporations.
The coastal village became a haven for artists seeking peace.

note: 'Tax haven' = thiên đường thuế. Khác 'harbour' (cảng) mặc dù từ nguyên liên quan.

senses.meaning: Nơi ẩn náu, nơi trú ẩn (khỏi nguy hiểm); nơi tị nạn
examples: The hikers took refuge in a cave when the storm broke.
She found refuge in her books during the difficult period.
Thousands sought refuge from the conflict across the border.

senses.meaning: Nơi trú ẩn (khỏi thời tiết, nguy hiểm); nơi tạm trú cho người vô gia cư/động vật
examples: They took shelter from the rain under a large tree.
The city opened emergency shelters for homeless people in winter.
An animal shelter rescues and rehomes abandoned pets.

senses.meaning: Che chở, bảo vệ; trú ẩn
examples: The trees sheltered the hikers from the wind.
She sheltered under a shop awning until the rain passed.
Parents naturally want to shelter their children from harm.

senses.meaning: Liên lục địa (giữa các châu lục)
examples: Intercontinental flights typically take twelve hours or more.
The missile has an intercontinental range of over 5,000 kilometres.
The hotel chain has intercontinental operations in over fifty countries.

senses.meaning: Đầm lầy sũng nước; tình thế bế tắc khó thoát
examples: The soldiers' boots sank deep into the quagmire.
The country risks getting sucked into an unwinnable quagmire.
The negotiations have turned into a political quagmire.

note: Nghĩa bóng rất phổ biến: 'political/military quagmire' = tình trạng sa lầy.

senses.meaning: Cảng (nơi tàu thuyền neo đậu)
examples: The fishing boats returned to harbour at sunset.
A new harbour was built to accommodate larger cruise ships.
The city's natural harbour was the reason for its founding.

senses.meaning: Che giấu, bao che; nuôi dưỡng (ý nghĩ, mối oán hận)
examples: She was accused of harbouring a known fugitive.
He harboured deep resentment about the way he had been treated.
Don't harbour negative thoughts — they only harm you.

note: Tiếng Anh Mỹ: 'harbor'. Nghĩa bóng 'harbour feelings' = ôm ấp cảm xúc âm thầm.

senses.meaning: Pháo đài (công trình phòng thủ kiên cố); nơi/tổ chức phòng thủ mạnh
examples: The medieval fortress overlooked the entire valley below.
The rebel forces stormed the mountain fortress at dawn.
The company's head office became a fortress during the hostile takeover.

senses.meaning: Sa mạc (vùng đất khô hạn, ít mưa)
examples: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
The desert bloomed briefly after the unexpected rainfall.
Temperatures in the desert can exceed 50°C in summer.

note: Phân biệt với 'dessert' (tráng miệng) — chỉ khác nhau 1 chữ 's'.

senses.meaning: Đỉnh đồi
examples: The village was perched on a hilltop overlooking the valley.
They climbed to the hilltop for a panoramic view.
The castle ruins on the hilltop could be seen for miles.

senses.meaning: Địa điểm (nơi tổ chức sự kiện, buổi biểu diễn, trận đấu)
examples: The concert venue holds 20,000 people.
We're still looking for a suitable venue for the wedding.
The trial was moved to a different venue due to security concerns.

senses.meaning: Đầm lầy, đất ngập nước
examples: The Florida Everglades is one of the largest swamps in the world.
Crocodiles lurk in the swamps of the Nile delta.
The construction site turned into a swamp after the heavy rains.

senses.meaning: Tràn ngập, nhấn chìm; (không chính thức) áp đảo bằng công việc/yêu cầu
examples: The village was swamped by floodwaters after the dam broke.
She was completely swamped with work after returning from holiday.
The helpline was swamped with calls during the outage.

senses.meaning: Vùng ngoại ô (khu dân cư bên ngoài trung tâm thành phố)
examples: They moved to the suburbs after their first child was born.
The commute from the suburb to downtown takes forty minutes.
The suburb has good schools and plenty of green space.

note: 'The suburbs' (số nhiều) = khu vực ngoại thành nói chung.

senses.meaning: Khu ổ chuột, khu nghèo đô thị với điều kiện sống kém
examples: Millions of people live in urban slums without access to clean water.
She grew up in a slum but worked her way to university.
The city demolished the slums and built public housing.

senses.meaning: Bờ biển, bờ hồ (chỗ đất tiếp giáp mặt nước)
examples: Children played on the shore while their parents watched from the beach.
The ship ran aground on the rocky shore.
He longed to return to his home shores after years abroad.

note: 'Shore' = bờ biển/hồ/sông. 'Coast' thường chỉ bờ biển quy mô lớn hơn.

senses.meaning: Thác nước nhỏ; dòng chảy tầng tầng lớp lớp; chuỗi liên tiếp
examples: A cascade of water fell over the mossy rocks.
A cascade of problems followed the initial mistake.
Her hair fell in cascades around her shoulders.

senses.meaning: Tuôn ra ào ạt, đổ xuống như thác; lan truyền theo chuỗi
examples: Water cascaded down the mountain after the heavy rain.
Information cascaded down through the management layers.
Light cascaded through the stained-glass window.

senses.meaning: Vách đá (bờ biển hoặc núi có sườn đứng)
examples: The hiker stood at the cliff edge and looked down at the sea.
The castle perched on a cliff high above the harbour.
Seabirds nest in the crevices of the chalk cliffs.

note: 'Cliffhanger' = tình huống căng thẳng chưa có hồi kết (gốc từ cảnh phim/tiểu thuyết rơi xuống vách đá).

senses.meaning: Bờ biển (vùng đất tiếp giáp biển)
examples: The storm caused damage all along the coast.
We drove down the scenic coast road from Nice to Monaco.
He retired to a cottage on the west coast of Ireland.

note: 'The coast is clear' (idiom) = không còn nguy hiểm/mối đe dọa nào nữa.

senses.meaning: Địa hình (tính chất và đặc điểm của bề mặt đất)
examples: The mountain terrain made driving extremely difficult.
Soldiers need to know how to navigate unfamiliar terrain.
The off-road vehicle was designed for rough terrain.

senses.meaning: Tiết ra, rỉ ra (chất lỏng); toát lên, phát ra (cảm giác, sự tự tin)
examples: Pine trees exude a sticky resin that traps insects.
She exudes confidence in every room she walks into.
The old house exuded an air of neglect and sadness.

note: Hai cách dùng: (1) vật lý: tiết ra chất lỏng/hơi; (2) nghĩa bóng: toát ra cảm giác/chất lượng nào đó.

senses.meaning: Sân thượng (mái bằng dùng để ngồi); dãy nhà liền kề; ruộng bậc thang
examples: They had breakfast on the hotel terrace overlooking the sea.
The block includes a rooftop terrace with panoramic city views.
Victorian terraces line both sides of the narrow street.

note: Ba nghĩa: (1) sân thượng/ban công rộng; (2) dãy nhà liền kề một kiểu ('terraced houses'); (3) ruộng bậc thang.

senses.meaning: Vỉa hè (Anh Anh); mặt đường nhựa (Anh Mỹ)
examples: She tripped on the uneven pavement and sprained her ankle.
A café put tables out on the pavement in summer.
The workers resurfaced the cracked pavement outside the school.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh: 'pavement' = vỉa hè; tiếng Anh Mỹ 'pavement' = mặt đường, còn vỉa hè = 'sidewalk'.

senses.meaning: Đê, bờ đất cao (dọc sông, đường sắt, hoặc đường bộ)
examples: They walked along the Thames Embankment on a sunny afternoon.
The railway embankment was reinforced after the flooding.
Willow trees line the embankment beside the river.

senses.meaning: Chuyến đi ngắn, chuyến tham quan (thường trong ngày)
examples: The school organized an excursion to the natural history museum.
We took a day excursion to the nearby islands.
A boat excursion along the coast was included in the package.

senses.meaning: Hẻm núi, vực sâu hẹp (do nước xói mòn)
examples: The hikers had to cross a narrow bridge over a deep ravine.
The river carved a ravine through the limestone over millions of years.
A body was found at the bottom of the ravine.

senses.meaning: Trang trại chăn nuôi lớn (thường ở Mỹ, chủ yếu nuôi gia súc)
examples: He grew up on a cattle ranch in Texas.
The ranch covers thousands of acres of open land.
She moved from the city to manage her family's ranch.

senses.meaning: Hồ chứa nước (nhân tạo hoặc tự nhiên); kho dự trữ
examples: The reservoir supplies water to the entire city.
Drought has left the reservoir at its lowest level in decades.
She has a vast reservoir of knowledge and experience.

note: Nghĩa bóng: 'a reservoir of' = nguồn dự trữ lớn về (kiến thức, năng lượng, v.v.).

senses.meaning: Sống núi, dãy núi hẹp; gờ nổi dài trên bề mặt
examples: The hikers followed the ridge to the summit.
A high-pressure ridge is moving in from the west, bringing clear skies.
There is a sharp ridge along the top of the roof.

senses.meaning: Nhà nghỉ (tại khu nghỉ dưỡng/khu săn bắn); nhà gác cổng
examples: They stayed at a ski lodge in the Alps for a week.
The safari lodge was nestled deep in the game reserve.
The security guard was stationed at the lodge by the gate.

senses.meaning: Nộp (đơn, khiếu nại) chính thức; ở tạm; mắc kẹt vào đâu đó
examples: She lodged a formal complaint with the management.
He lodged with a local family while studying abroad.
A fish bone lodged in his throat.

senses.meaning: Gờ đá, bệ nhỏ nhô ra (trên vách đá hoặc tường); bậu cửa sổ
examples: The climber rested on a narrow ledge halfway up the cliff.
A pigeon sat on the window ledge looking in.
Don't leave anything on the window ledge — it might fall.

senses.meaning: Đại lộ, phố rộng; phương hướng, cách tiếp cận (cơ hội, giải pháp)
examples: The parade moved down Fifth Avenue to the cheers of the crowd.
Several avenues were explored before a solution was found.
This new partnership opens up exciting avenues for growth.

note: Nghĩa bóng: 'explore every avenue' = thử mọi hướng tiếp cận.

senses.meaning: Ngõ hẻm (đường nhỏ hẹp giữa các tòa nhà)
examples: The mugger followed her down a dark alley.
The restaurant's back door opened onto a service alley.
Cats prowled the alleys behind the market stalls.

note: 'Up someone's alley' (idiom) = đúng sở thích/chuyên môn của ai.

senses.meaning: Bể cá (tại nhà); thủy cung (cơ sở tham quan công cộng)
examples: She has a large tropical aquarium in her living room.
The children loved watching the sharks at the city aquarium.
The aquarium recently added a coral reef exhibit.

senses.meaning: Khe nứt sâu trên sông băng; vết nứt lớn
examples: The mountaineer fell into a hidden crevasse and was injured.
Explorers must probe the snow ahead to detect crevasses.
Satellite images revealed new crevasses opening in the ice sheet.

note: Chủ yếu dùng cho khe nứt trong sông băng. 'Crevice' = khe nứt nhỏ trong đá.

senses.meaning: Vườn cây ăn quả
examples: The farm has a large apple orchard behind the barn.
They went apple-picking in the orchard in autumn.
The ancient orchard produces some of the finest cherries in the region.

senses.meaning: Hành lang (trong tòa nhà); hành lang (địa lý/ngoại giao: dải đất kết nối hai vùng)
examples: She hurried down the corridor to reach the meeting room in time.
The children were running in the corridors between classes.
The Danzig Corridor was a key flashpoint before World War II.

senses.meaning: Nơi giải tỏa (cảm xúc/năng lượng); ổ cắm điện; cửa hàng giảm giá; lối thoát của nước
examples: Music became an outlet for her emotions after the divorce.
Plug the appliance into the nearest outlet.
The factory outlet sells items at discounted prices.

senses.meaning: Lục địa (một trong bảy khối đất liền lớn của Trái Đất)
examples: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
The explorer was the first to cross the continent on foot.
Trade between continents was revolutionised by the shipping container.

senses.meaning: Đầm lầy, đồng lầy (đất ẩm ướt, thường có cỏ lau)
examples: Migratory birds flock to the coastal marshes every winter.
The soldiers found it almost impossible to cross the marshy ground.
The nature reserve protects an important area of salt marsh.

senses.meaning: Đê, đập đất ngăn nước; tường đá nông thôn
examples: The dykes of the Netherlands protect much of the country from flooding.
Workers reinforced the dykes after the storm warning.
Dry-stone dykes divide the hillside pastures in the Scottish countryside.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng 'dyke'; tiếng Anh Mỹ: 'dike'.

senses.meaning: Vùng đất hoang rộng lớn, thường ở trên cao, phủ đầy cây thạch thảo (moorland)
examples: The Yorkshire Moors are popular with hikers and birdwatchers.
A thick fog rolled across the moor as night fell.
The moors of northern England have an atmosphere of wild solitude.

senses.meaning: Neo đậu (tàu thuyền); buộc vào bờ
examples: The boat was moored to the dock for the night.
They moored the yacht in the harbour and went ashore.
Visitors can moor their boats at the marina.

senses.meaning: Đường đi bộ ven biển/công viên; khu dạo chơi
examples: We strolled along the promenade as the sun set over the sea.
The seaside promenade was packed with tourists in summer.
A new promenade was built along the riverbank.

senses.meaning: Dạo bộ (cách điệu, trang trọng)
examples: Couples promenaded along the boulevard on Sunday afternoons.
Victorian ladies promenaded in the park to be seen.
The guests promenaded through the grand gallery before dinner.
